Road conditions

  • 800-ICY-ROAD-Road conditions
  • http://www.511vt.com/default.asp?area=VT_statewide (Road conditions map)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8’6” wide; over 13’6” high; trailer over 68’ long

Special Information Needed

  • Vermont HUT#
  • Times Of Movement

½ hour before sunrise to ½ hour after sunset

  • Vehicles which are overweight only and are capable of traveling with the flow of traffic may travel 24hrs.
  • No weekend travel for loads greater than 108,000 lbs./10’6” wide/100’ long or on Friday afternoons (7/1-Labor Day) or on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Columbus Day, Martin Luther King Day, July 4th, Veteran’s Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Presidents’ Day including the preceding Friday if a holiday falls on a Saturday and the following Monday if a holiday falls on a Sunday
  • See provision sheet or permit for special instructions/curfews or call (802)828-2064

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.dmv.state.vt.us/documents/TA/VX/TAVX012.pdf
  • Width of 12’ or more-1
  • Height greater than 14’-1 w/ height pole (as determined by DOT)
  • Length of 80’ or more-1
  • Overhang of 15’ or more-1
  • Large or hazardous moves-2 (front & rear; may need police escort)

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Lights: Flashing amber light above the highest point of the vehicle; must be visible from the front & rear
  • Signs: Front escort vehicle must have a sign on the front of the vehicle
  • Rear escort vehicle must have a sign on the rear of the vehicle
  • “Oversized Load” signs at least 5’ long & 12” high; 10” high/1 5/8” wide letters; black on yellow
  • Additional equipment: Headlights on low beam

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • No special certification noted in rules & regulations
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office- Office hours: 7:45a.m.-4:30 p.m. ET; Mon.-Fri.
  • Dept of Motor Vehicles
  • Commercial Vehicle Permit Unit
  • 120 State Street
  • Montpelier, VT 05603
  • 802-828-2064; fax: 802-828-5418
  • http://www.dmv.state.vt.us/COMMERCIAL/CVPermittingRules.htm
